Politics · India

PM Modi urges forgiveness for students after protest remarks

Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that while the language used by some student protesters was unacceptable in a civilized society, he forgives them and urges for their guidance rather than retribution. His remarks came amidst protests and criticism directed at Home Minister Amit Shah over police action. Modi was reportedly absent from Parliament during discussions on the student protests.
